verdict.rationale: Together's structured-outputs docs say supported models return JSON that conforms to any schema you supply, so output can be read directly in code without retries or fragile parsing. That is the core of this story. Function calling adds structured tool names and arguments. Missing for 10: support is limited to 'supported models' with no list of which ones, there is no evidence of grammar or regex-constrained decoding, there are no details on schema features or strict-mode guarantees, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
